items.title: Alex Bigard Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] You're one of the few drummers that can seem to play a melody on the drums. You get a melody out of them, and that wasn't solo on Tiger Ray. [INTERVIEWEE] Oh, yeah.

ctx.x: Pete played clarinet. Albert played trumpet. And Adolphe, he played piano, but Adolphe got killed in an automobile accident. All right. What kind of a set of drums did you have when you started? How big a bass drum? You just showed us your bass drum. I had the same size drum that I have now, 14 by 28. And I just set a Ludwig drum. But those are not the same drums. What thing is this? That's a Ludwig. That's a Ludwig drum. Yeah. You say it has a good tone, better than most tones. Yeah, it's wonderful. It has a…
You're one of the few drummers that can seem to play a melody on the drums. You get a melody out of them, and that wasn't solo on Tiger Ray.
